skills.title: Skills
skills.intro: The skills the agent proposes and the workspace skills that wait for you. Nothing loads until you apply or accept it here, in Telegram or in the terminal.
skills.none: No skill proposal waits for you.
skills.blocked: Its scan found problems, so it cannot be applied. Reject it, or ask the agent to revise it:
skills.applyAsk: Apply this proposal to skill {name}? It loads from the agent's next turn.
skills.waiting: New or changed, so it does not load. Check its files at {location} first.

safety.title: Safety
safety.intro: A freeze and a rescue work at once from here. An unfreeze opens a card, and nothing unfreezes until you confirm it, here or on any surface.
safety.calm: Nothing is frozen. A freeze stops trading at once: open cards and unsigned actions are cancelled, auto orders pause, and a transaction already sent finishes.
safety.installFrozen: Every agent is frozen since {when}, and every agent made until an unfreeze starts frozen.
safety.agentState: {state, select, frozen {Frozen since {when}} breaker {Held by bInference's breaker} other {Not frozen}}
safety.freezeAsk: {scope, select, all {Freeze every agent now? Their open cards and unsigned actions are cancelled and their auto orders pause; a transaction already sent finishes. Every agent made until an unfreeze starts frozen.} other {Freeze {name} now? Its open cards and unsigned actions are cancelled and its auto orders pause; a transaction already sent finishes.}}
safety.frozen: Frozen since {when}. Every surface announces it.
safety.unfreezeOpened: The unfreeze card waits below. Nothing unfreezes until you confirm it, here or on any surface.
safety.unfreezeNothing: Nothing is frozen, so there is nothing to unfreeze.
safety.noScope: This connection can read what is frozen, but not freeze, unfreeze or rescue.
safety.rescueAbout: A rescue moves everything every agent wallet holds, except each wallet's gas reserve, to your rescue address. It works while frozen and in paper mode, and it never sells.
safety.noRescueAddress: No rescue address is set, so no rescue can open. Set one on the machine with `binference rescue set` and your own wallet's address.
safety.pendingRescue: It changes to `{address}` at {when}. Not you? Run `binference rescue cancel` on the machine.
safety.rescueUnderWay: A rescue is under way: {state, select, awaiting_confirmation {waiting for your confirmation} confirmed {confirmed} executing {sending} included {sent, waiting to be final} finalized {final, being recorded} other {{state}}}.
safety.rescueOpened: The rescue card waits below. Check the rescue address on it, then confirm it here or on any surface.
